node.statement: Fix a coordinate i. Since the H-CB datum makes Q a level-one one-dimensional delta-projection and Y_i,V_i lie in S_{P,Q}, the registered column-hilbert-corner definition applies and gives Y_i^dagger dot V_i = <Y_i,V_i>*\widetilde Q. Substitution of the definitional abbreviation u_Q=\widetilde Q from the preceding child yields Y_i^dagger dot V_i = <Y_i,V_i>*u_Q, exactly the coordinate identity asserted in node 1.3.1.
